# List Repository Issue Types With MCP

Use the available GitHub MCP or repository tooling to list the issue types configured for this Digital Patterning System
Simulator repository. Provide a brief description of each issue type, including its purpose and when workshop maintainers
should use it.

Frame examples around this repository's work areas when useful:

- C#/.NET operator dashboard, gateway host, domain services, and tests
- C++ pattern processor
- C control emulator
- SQL schema and validation
- PLC and FPGA stubs
- Codespaces/devcontainer setup
- README, PRD, prompts, and workshop documentation

Do not edit files for this prompt. If MCP access is unavailable or the repository has no custom issue types, say so
clearly and provide a short fallback issue-type taxonomy suitable for this project.
